personal.name: Joe Tao
personal.summary: Product Designer trained at UCL (MSc Human-Computer Interaction, Distinction), with 3+ years shipping research-led product experiences and design systems across UK and China. Experienced in Figma libraries, design tokens, reusable patterns, documentation, usability testing, WCAG-aware design, and AI-assisted prototyping. Full lifecycle from discovery to delivery, with design systems adopted across cross-functional teams, 2x checkout conversion, 40% faster feature design cycles, and 30% reduced design-to-build time. Research contributed to ACM CHIWORK '25; findings pitched to Google.
